purpose: Create source-grounded Pawline SEO drafts for human review. This contract does not publish content.
guardrails: Research is limited to public HTTPS results returned by the configured research provider.
The model may use only the supplied research results for factual assertions and citations.
Drafts must not make medical, legal, financial, availability, adoption-outcome, or compatibility guarantees.
Every draft is stored for human review; the pipeline has no publish, sitemap, or indexing action.
